description: This file defines the UploadedFile class implementing the UploadedFileInterface, handling uploaded file data including validation, stream management, and file movement.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: Represents an uploaded file, providing methods for validation, stream access, and moving the uploaded file.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an UploadedFile instance with stream or filename, size, error status, and optional client info.

methods.name: validateActive
methods.description: Checks if the file is in a valid state for operations, throwing exceptions if not.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a stream of the uploaded file, opening the file if necessary.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified target path.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error status of the upload.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the client-provided filename, if available.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the client-provided media type, if available.
